title: PCR02 v1.1.21 OTA artifact identity contract
goal: Make the existing PCR02 v1.1.21 OTA package identity machine-readable and fail-closed without changing package bytes.
non_goals: Do not install the OTA on a device.
Do not claim device boot, rollback, or release readiness.
current_behavior: Package identity was documented for human use but was not enforced by a machine-readable manifest and verifier.
expected_behavior: A machine-readable manifest and fail-closed verifier deterministically bind the exact PCR02 v1.1.21 OTA artifact to its canonical repository, exact source commit, Git blob identity, package path, byte size and SHA-256.
acceptance_criteria: Machine-readable manifest binds repository jiying2007/ota_download_test, source commit eeb926bd1fff75d2a5d5abb9f0ede9c8f582cc6d, source blob dc4fe914ab618fa208287de90731bd2ca9c1c3a7, package path ota_pkg_v1.1.21.tar.gz, size 76,778,472 bytes and SHA-256 7687d8058f85271e75ff3726957385afa1618aa2078dc0a6b3215d470af4a4bb.
Verifier rejects malformed identity, path traversal, source-identity mismatch, size mismatch, SHA mismatch and duplicate checksum entries.
Hosted CI is configured to verify the real 76,778,472-byte package and retain a machine receipt.
constraints: Hosted CI must not be interpreted as device/release PASS.
approval_policy: Device write or release action requires separate human approval and is outside this Feature Pilot.
blocker_policy: Block if canonical repository, exact source commit, source blob, package path, byte size or SHA-256 identity cannot be proven.
